text: Decisions for the plan, from the last critique: (1) The remote is the source of truth for athena/records. Build the records commit on the remote tip, push it with a lease on that tip, and move the local ref only after the push succeeds; on a rejected push, fetch the new remote tip, rebuild the commit on it and retry, a bounded number of times. A local ref ahead of or diverged from the remote is reset to the remote before writing, since every records commit that matters is on the remote. (2) If the host merged but land cannot confirm the merge, write no landing record and print a warning naming the intent; job 3 part 2 (reconcile) repairs it. (3) Cover the drain.rs caller of land_pr the same way. (4) An error for a commit without a landing or verification names its sha and says it lies between the remote base and the PR head.
